parameters.name: Deliver
parameters.description: The method that is used to send operations reports. Operations reports are sent to you only by email. The settings need to be escaped in JSON.

parameters.name: DeliverId
parameters.description: The ID of the tracking task that you want to update.

parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The domain names from which the tracking task collects data. Separate domain names with commas (,). If you do not specify a domain name, the task collects data from all domain names that belong to your Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the tracking task.

parameters.name: Reports
parameters.description: The operations reports that are tracked by the task. The data needs to be escaped in JSON.

parameters.name: Schedule
parameters.description: The parameters that specify the time interval at which the tracking task sends operations reports. The settings need to be escaped in JSON.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn update-dcdn-deliver-task --deliver-id 92 --name Domain_subscription --reports reportId_:2,_conditions_:_field_:_prov_,_op_:_in_,_value_:_Heilongjiang_,_Beijing --domain-name www.example.com --deliver email_:_subject_:_topic_name_,_to_:_username@example.com_,_username@example.com --schedule schedName_:_subscription_task_name_,_description_:_description_,_crontab_:_000000_,_frequency_:_d_,_status_:_enable_,_effectiveFrom_:_2020-09-17T00:00:00Z_,_effectiveEnd_:_2020-11-17T00:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
